parameters.content:
# Shopify Orders to Airtable, with Melt-Risk Check
Shopify orders/create and orders/updated webhooks keep Customers, Orders and Order Lines in Airtable up to date, and every new order gets a weather check for the shipping city. Import and **activate** `shared/error-alert-slack.json`, then pick it as this workflow's Error Workflow. Settings come from `$env` (see `.env.example`).

## 1. Receive and verify
The raw body is signed again with `SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (HMAC SHA256, base64) and compared with `X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256`. Wrong or missing signature: 401 and a failed run. No secret set: 500, nothing is trusted. A real order gets 200 right away and the work happens after the answer, because Shopify wants a reply within 5 seconds.

## 2. Let updates settle, skip repeats and stale updates
Shopify often sends orders/updated a moment after orders/create, so an update waits 10 seconds and the create is saved first. Webhook Log holds every `X-Shopify-Webhook-Id` already processed, so a repeat delivery does nothing. Shopify does not promise the order of webhooks: one older than the stored `Shopify Updated At` is logged as Ignored. This is checked again after an Airtable cooldown, because another webhook may have saved a newer version in the meantime.

## 3. Customer and products
The customer is looked up by Shopify Customer ID, then by `LOWER(TRIM({Email}))` (never an upsert on Email), then updated by record id or created. SKUs are matched to Products, trimmed and in upper case. An unknown SKU becomes a Draft product with Needs Review ticked, 10 per request.

## 4. Melt-risk check
Open-Meteo geocoding finds the shipping city (`City, ST`, country filter), the daily forecast gives `temperature_2m_max` for the next `MELT_FORECAST_DAYS` days. Any day at or above `MELT_TEMP_C` means Cold Pack Required. A failed call or an unknown city means Review, with a note that says why. Runs for new orders, a changed address, or a previous Review.

## 5. Save the order, then alert
One upsert on `Shopify Order ID` (create and update are the same call). The packing channel hears about Cold Pack Required or Review, the ops channel about new Draft products. A failed Slack post never stops the sync; the run is marked failed at the end. Text from the shop and its customers (gift notes, names, titles) is escaped for Slack, so it cannot ping a channel or post a link.

## 6. Lines and logs
Order Lines are upserted on `Line Item ID`, 10 per request. Every Airtable call waits 500 ms after the last one: the limit is 5 per second per base, so two webhooks at once still fit. Webhook Log and Sync Log rows close the run.

## Airtable errors
Every Airtable call tries 3 times. Then a 429, a 5xx or no answer waits 31 to 60 seconds and starts this webhook again (lookups and upserts are safe to repeat, alerts are never sent twice), up to 3 attempts. Anything else marks the webhook Failed and stops the run, so the error workflow posts to Slack.
